schoolLibrary._comment: Admin App > Library tab (module LIBR). Captured live on Thor / FCN-CHZ-PDA 2026-09-11 - see .architecture/product-knowledge/ExperienceApp/admin-library-tab.md. WARNINGS: (1) productRowByTitle is a TEMPLATE - replace {{title}} with the product title; it resolves the row by its aria-label ('See <title>'), which is STABLE, unlike the positional qid aLibrary-4-<n>. umbrellaProduct._comment: Admin App > product materials view reached by 'See materials' (module UMBP). Captured live on Thor 2026-09-11 - see admin-library-tab.md. This page is VUE (data-v-*), NOT the Angular admin app, and it lives on the TEACHER route /dashboard/teacher/org_<slug>/bundle/<id>/view. WARNINGS: (1) TWO h2 exist and the FIRST is 'Download the Cambridge One Desktop App' - a bare h2 matches the wrong one, so learningMaterialsHeading is scoped to section.umbrella-components. (2) EVERY component tile carries the SAME qid t-prd-cmp-cntr-1 (12 on one product, 15 on another) - the qid cannot address one tile; index or text it. (3) componentName is ALWAYS PRESENT but EMPTY for a component with no name - count it and you get a false green; read its TEXT. (4) backLink (t-prd-umb-link-1) DROPS THE SCHOOL CONTEXT - requests /admin/admin//library and lands on My school accounts; re-navigate via the school card instead (TST_UMBP_TC_10).

adminNotifications._comment: Admin App notifications bell + panel (module INVI extension, TC_7..12). Captured live 2026-09-14, admin-shared.md §A9/§A12. WARNINGS: (1) the panel is built lazily by tippy.js — nothing to read until the bell is clicked (the §B2 pre-render rule does NOT apply). (2) .notification-dropdown is the 56px bell WRAPPER, not the panel — never use it as the panel selector. (3) two VISIBLE elements share qid ntf-2 (.close and .close-dummy) — closeBtn targets .close-dummy — it overlays .close and receives the real click (verified 2026-09-14). (4) row qids are positional and based at 30 (ntf-30..ntf-34). (5) only 5 rows render regardless of the unread total; the panel does not scroll. (6) opening the panel does NOT change the unread count; clicking a row marks it read and cannot be undone.

myProfile._comment: Shared Cambridge One profile page /dashboard/my-profile (module MYPR). NOT under /admin/ — a change here reaches teachers and students too. Captured live 2026-09-14, admin-shared.md §A9/§A12. WARNINGS: (1) three names for one page: menu 'My profile', title 'My profile | Cambridge One', heading 'Manage profile' — assert the heading. (2) the active tab IS identifiable: its parent li gets class 'selected'. (3) the tabs SWAP DOM (inputs 5-7 absent on Personal info) and the swap takes >1 s. (4) Cancel has TWO qids — c-mp-btn-2 on Personal info, c-mp-btn-4 on Password. (5) Update is input[type=submit] — assert its value, its text is empty. (6) NEVER click Update on testt1 — it is the login for every admin suite.

changeSchoolKey._comment: School settings menu + the IRREVERSIBLE Change school key warning (module SKEY). Captured live 2026-09-14, admin-shared.md §A10/§A12. 🚨 continueBtn PERMANENTLY CHANGES THE SCHOOL KEY — no page-object method may ever click it; it exists only so tests can assert it is present. 🚨 TST_SKEY_TC_4 runs on KNF-XRD-QVE, NEVER FCN-CHZ-PDA [user decision 2026-09-14]. WARNINGS: (1) the dialog is pre-rendered and hidden — scope every dialog selector with #changeSchoolKey (the Classes tab holds 5 .modal-content). (2) closed = modal display:none AND no .modal-backdrop AND no body.modal-open — never the 'show' class. (3) a synthetic .click() on Cancel did not close the dialog during grounding; Escape did (fade <=1.5 s). (4) adEdit qids are NOT contiguous: 1 trigger, 2/7/8 menu items, 3/4 dialog buttons.

setupSchoolWizard._comment: Set up a school account wizard, /dashboard/teacher/setupschool (module SRQS, TST_SRQS_TC_3). Walked live on Thor 2026-09-14 to the summary — 'Send Request' NEVER clicked, admin-shared.md §A12. 🚨 sendRequestBtn SUBMITS A REAL INSTITUTION REQUEST into a human queue (TST_SRQS_TC_2 is Blocked for this reason) — no page-object method may click it. 🚨 The existing wizard modules' generic primaryBtn 'button.btn-purple' ALSO matches Send Request — a step-looping helper will submit. Every Next below is addressed by its OWN qid. WARNINGS: (1) the wizard advances IN-PAGE — the URL never changes; the step is identified by which Next qid is visible. (2) Next is NATIVELY disabled (disabled attr) until the step is valid — assert with isEnabled. (3) the Next qid numbering varies per step (btn-1 / btn-2) — never infer it. (4) radio inputs are opacity 0 — click the LABEL. (5) location and telephone code arrive PRE-FILLED from the account — read them, never hardcode. (6) no inline error text appears in any blocked state.
